flight_launch_model: impact_parameters.flight_report (clubhead state at contact, strike offset on the face)

sources.replay_kind_tags: Tag of the motion a clip shows, per replay_mode value (replay_mode.py): a kinematic replay and an inverse-dynamics clip show the recorded motion (measured); tracked and open-loop dynamics show a motion the efforts were fitted to reproduce; an undetermined mode is unknown.
sources.fit_error_keys: Bundle provenance keys, in order, that record how far the shown motion is from its target: max_pose_drift_m is written by the closed-loop bundle writer (motion_matching/same_input/reference.py); kinetic_match.closure_gap_max_m by the kinetic match (motion_matching/kinetic_match.py). A dotted key reads a nested record. None present gives unknown.
sources.golfer_model_tag: The golfer is the bundle spec as built (topology and segment parameters); the card names it by spec hash and revision and makes no claim that its parameters were measured on the golfer.
sources.club_tag: Club and shaft come from the spec club record; the chain shaft profile is a generic flex flagged default_not_measured (club_shaft_chain.py), and a rigid club has no flex.
sources.shot_setup_tag: Club roll, ball shift and shot shape are export settings chosen by the user (shot_setup.py); the ball is a display placement (ball.py).
sources.impact_model_tag: The bundle's latched ball force (GCV-20) uses an assumed COR and ball mass; the exporter's flight is launched by the impact model from the replayed clubhead state.
